purpose: Storefront checkout for promotional orders. Redirects the shopper to the hosted page, then fulfills on return. The same code path handles a paid cart and a cart a 100%-off promo has taken to zero.

reads.note: branches the fulfillment arming: `always` means a payment method will be collected and the order is armed to wait for a PaymentIntent, anything else routes to the no-payment path
written to the order row as the amount the shopper is expected to pay
the hosted page the shopper is redirected to. Declared because it is read, and flagged as a blind spot: redaction drops this value at capture, so the lab can never report a difference on it
the fulfillment gate: anything other than `paid` leaves the order unfulfilled
read again on return, because the arming decision made at create is not trusted across the redirect
stored against the order so finance can match the settlement later; the no-payment path expects this to be absent

sequence.note: Declared with no reads on purpose. On 2022-11-15 this call is a 400 and the storefront's promo path dead-ends in its error handler; on basil the session is created. A status change is a property of the call rather than of any field, so it lands here without a declared locus.
